group: E0-02 real-agent raw-data analysis (previous round, same HEAD/binary)
notes: This is a post-hoc analysis pass only: no daemons/agents were spawned in this turn. All evidence is re-read from /private/tmp/.../79983209-.../scratchpad/e2e/{claude-smoke-1,codex-smoke-1,codex-smoke-2}/{result.json,sse.jsonl,daemon.log,workdir/NOTES.md} plus provider-local logs (~/.claude/projects, ~/.codex/sessions) and the APPROVAL_TTL_SECS constant read from crates/interaction-runtime/src/gateway.rs. Three cases: E0-02-claude (claude-code, claimed-completed in 11.2s), E0-02-codex-noapprove (codex, stuck waiting-for-consent because harness never approved; run stopped at 303.34s wall, 8s before the 300s auto-deny deadline measured from the approval-request's own creation time), E0-02-codex-approve (codex, --approve approve, claimed-completed in 17.0s). None of the three final records carries a 'verified' field at all (not false/null -- the field is simply absent from the AgentSession record's JSON shape), which is itself an honesty-ladder observation worth flagging, not just a defect search.

cases.scenario: Real codex agent session with the harness NOT approving the resulting command-execution approval request: dispatch the same read-only NOTES.md task, observe the session get stuck at waiting-for-consent, and determine whether the 300s auto-deny watchdog is exercised.
cases.agentOrSurface: HTTP API -> interaction-runtime AgentGateway -> codex connector (codex app-server JSON-RPC v2, sandbox_policy=read-only, approval_policy=untrusted)
cases.precondition: Isolated daemon (INTERACT_AI_HOME=.../codex-smoke-1/home, port from prior round), workdir contains NOTES.md with first heading '# 階段零煙霧測試'. allowWrite=false. Harness ran with no --approve flag, i.e. never called POST .../approve.
steps: POST .../messages {kind: task, body:{task: same NOTES.md question}}

codex issues item/commandExecution/requestApproval for '/bin/zsh -lc "cat NOTES.md"' -- this reaches the gateway as an approval-request mailbox message at 2026-09-07T03:45:30.630Z, session state -> waiting-for-consent
Harness does NOT call POST .../approve; instead polls SSE/mailbox/status and daemon.log up to a 180s-per-turn / harness wall-clock budget
Harness stops the daemon at wallSeconds=303.34 (measured from session creation, 2026-09-07T03:45:19.102Z), i.e. around 2026-09-07T03:50:22.44Z
Capture final record state, auditTail, SSE tail for keep-alive cadence

expected.coreState: Session stays in waiting-for-consent (never auto-approved -- AI cannot self-consent). If left running past APPROVAL_TTL_SECS=300s from the approval-request's own creation, the gateway_sweep watchdog should auto-deny it (state stays waiting-for-consent or moves per resolve_approval_as('watchdog', approve=false) path) and report progress/waiting-for-consent with approvalAutoDenied + delivered:true/false.
expected.effect: No command actually executes (cat NOTES.md never runs) since approval was never granted; no file changes; codex remains blocked pending a decision it cannot make itself.

cases.actual: Session correctly halted at waiting-for-consent per the 'AI 不可授予 consent' invariant: the approval-request mailbox message (msg-...-2) recorded body.summary='codex 請求核可：item/commandExecution/requestApproval "/bin/zsh -lc '\''cat NOTES.md'\''"' at 2026-09-07T03:45:30.630Z, and the final record's state is still 'waiting-for-consent' with budget.spentMessages=2, spentCost=0.0 (no result ever produced, correctly -- nothing was claimed as completed). auditTail's last entry is character.session.truth revision=4 truth='waiting-consent' at the same timestamp, matching the API-level state. HOWEVER: the auto-deny watchdog (APPROVAL_TTL_SECS=300s constant at crates/interaction-runtime/src/gateway.rs:29, enforced every runtime tick via gateway_sweep() at crates/interaction-runtime/src/runtime.rs:2419) was NOT observed firing in this data. The approval's deadline (per gateway.rs:427, deadline = created_at + approval_ttl_secs) is 2026-09-07T03:50:30.630Z (approval created 03:45:30.630 + 300s), but the harness stopped the daemon at ~03:50:22.44Z -- about 8 seconds BEFORE the deadline. SSE keep-alive lines (every 15s) run up to 2026-09-07T03:50:15.670Z and then stop; there is no approval-resolved / approvalAutoDenied mailbox message anywhere in messages-from-session (only the single approval-request message exists), and no watchdog-actor entry appears in auditTail. So the watchdog behavior is UNCONFIRMED by this dataset -- the run simply ended too early to observe it, this is a harness/data gap, not evidence the watchdog is broken. Codex sandbox correctly required approval for a bare 'cat' inside a read-only sandbox with approval_policy=untrusted, matching the documented connector behavior (COMMON facts: 'so even cat NOTES.md 都會要求核可').
evidence: e2e/codex-smoke-1/result.json: final.state='waiting-for-consent', messages-from-session (single approval-request message, requestId '0'), budget.spentCost=0.0, budget.spentMessages=2, wallSeconds=303.34
e2e/codex-smoke-1/result.json: auditTail (9 entries), last = character.session.truth truth='waiting-consent' at 2026-09-07T03:45:30.630Z
e2e/codex-smoke-1/sse.jsonl: 19 unlabeled keep-alive lines at 15s cadence, last at 2026-09-07T03:50:15.670Z (8s before the 03:50:30.630Z approval deadline)

crates/interaction-runtime/src/gateway.rs:28-29 (APPROVAL_TTL_SECS=300, doc comment 'approval 無人裁決的自動拒絕時限'), gateway.rs:427 (deadline = now + approval_ttl_secs at approval-request creation), gateway.rs:1034-1105 (gateway_sweep denies any approval past deadline via resolve_approval_as(..., 'watchdog'))

crates/interaction-runtime/src/runtime.rs:2419 (runtime.gateway_sweep().await called on every ticker tick inside the daemon's main loop, i.e. it is automatic, not something the harness needed to trigger)
observations: This is a correct block, not a bug: the gateway never auto-approved and the record never claims completion it did not reach -- state honestly stuck at waiting-for-consent with spentCost=0.0.

The 300s auto-deny watchdog logic exists in code and runs automatically every daemon tick (no external trigger needed), but this specific run's harness stopped ~8s short of the deadline, so the auto-deny path itself was NOT exercised or captured in this dataset -- it remains a code-level (static) confirmation only, not an observed runtime behavior in E0-02.

SSE for codex shows the same coarse state-only granularity as claude, plus explicit keep-alive heartbeat lines every 15s (which claude-smoke-1's SSE did not need to use, since that run finished in 11.2s).
cases.limitations: Cannot confirm or deny whether gateway_sweep's auto-deny actually fires correctly at T+300s from this dataset alone -- the harness run ended ~8s before the deadline. A dedicated follow-up run that waits past 300s from the approval-request's creation (not from session creation) would be needed to observe the auto-deny transition directly; this analysis pass did not run one (no new daemons were spawned in this turn per the task's instructions).
cases.cleanup: None needed (read-only analysis; the source daemon from the prior round was already stopped before this turn began).

Ground truth (workdir/NOTES.md line 1 = '# 階段零煙霧測試') matches the agent's summary exactly. Final record: state=claimed-completed, claimId=claim-53400ca0-..., budget.spentCost=0.0 (codex connector never reports a cost figure, unlike claude-code), budget.spentMessages=4, providerSessionId=01a079fd-9402-79a2-b831-4241b7452d62, wallSeconds=17.01. codex's budget.spentCost stayed 0.0 even on a successful completion -- unlike claude-code, the codex connector in this repo does not surface a per-session cost figure into budget.spentCost, so cost accounting is asymmetric across the two supported agents.

Only the approve=true wire path ('accept') was exercised across all three cases in this dataset; the deny/'reject' path noted as a COMMON open question ('reject' 是否被接受要實測) was NOT tested by any of these three runs and remains unverified.
cases.limitations: Only the approve=true path was exercised; approve=false ('reject' wire value) was not tested in this round's raw data, so its acceptance by codex 0.153.4's v2 schema remains unconfirmed by direct observation (open question carried from COMMON facts).

openQuestions: Does gateway_sweep's 300s auto-deny actually fire and produce an approvalAutoDenied progress message + waiting-for-consent state with delivered:false when a codex approval request truly goes unanswered past its deadline? Not observed in E0-02 (harness stopped ~8s short of the deadline in codex-smoke-1). A dedicated run timed from the approval-request's own creation timestamp (not session start) past 300s would confirm.

Is there ANY code path that sets a 'verified' field on an AgentSession record (e.g. only after POST .../verify is explicitly called), or does the record schema simply never carry that field? All three E0-02 final records omit it entirely rather than showing false/null.

Does the codex connector's approve=false path actually send a wire value codex 0.153.4's v2 schema accepts ('reject' vs the schema's decline/cancel/etc.), given crates/interaction-agent-gateway/src/codex.rs:643-644 sends 'accept'/'reject' but the CommandExecutionApprovalDecision schema documented in COMMON only lists accept/acceptForSession/acceptWithExecpolicyAmendment/decline/cancel? Not tested in E0-02 (only approve=true was exercised).
